integrity: The theorem is supported by an explicit proof that tracks the only scalar divisions in the source argument, an independent characteristic-free ordinary-Zinbiel theorem, and a supplementary symbolic checker. Finite computations are not used as proof of the infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: No claim is made in characteristics 2 or 3.
The nilpotency-index bound 3n+1 is uniform but not claimed optimal.
Very recent or unindexed work could still contain the same positive-characteristic extension or quantitative bound.
title: Positive-characteristic nilpotency for finite-dimensional binary Zinbiel algebras
